_doc: Published wiki figure registry. Figure paths resolve relative to wiki/explorer/.

monthly_trade_3y.title: Monthly cross-border trade, FY 2079/80 to 2081/82
monthly_trade_3y.caption: Three-year monthly net-trade seasonality from NEA annual-report trade comparison tables.
monthly_trade_3y.caveat: Annual-report comparison chart totals differ slightly from NEA narrative totals.

fleet_capacity_mix.title: Hydropower fleet capacity mix and seasonal generation split
fleet_capacity_mix.caption: Installed hydropower is dominated by RoR/PRoR, while annual generation remains strongly wet-season weighted.
fleet_capacity_mix.caveat: Fleet taxonomy varies by reporting source; FY 2022/23 seasonal split is single-year.

basin_seasonality_compare.title: Basin monsoon concentration comparison
basin_seasonality_compare.caption: Basin-level monsoon concentration from the checked public source stack.
basin_seasonality_compare.caveat: Metrics mix runoff, surface flow, and rainfall depending on available public source.

storage_gap.title: Current storage capacity versus JICA-estimated storage need
storage_gap.caption: Nepal's current operational storage hydro is tiny relative to the 2032 storage need cited in planning literature.
storage_gap.caveat: JICA storage-need estimates are electricity-system planning needs; current storage uses Kulekhani operational capacity.

electricity_trade_shift.title: Electricity trade shift from net import to seasonal export
electricity_trade_shift.caption: Annual trade volumes show Nepal's transition from heavy importer to seasonal exporter.
electricity_trade_shift.caveat: Annual totals hide the wet-export and dry-import monthly structure shown in monthly_trade_3y.

lead1_fy2081_82_trade_vs_storage.title: FY 2081/82 trade versus storage generation
lead1_fy2081_82_trade_vs_storage.caption: Imports, exports, and storage generation in the same FY 2081/82 monthly frame.
lead1_fy2081_82_trade_vs_storage.caveat: Compact wiki figure excludes daily-report parsed points; see the lead-1 table for daily subset coverage.

license_type_mix.title: Hydropower license-stage mix
license_type_mix.caption: Pipeline split by license stage in the public hydropower project dataset.
license_type_mix.caveat: Licensing-stage counts are administrative status snapshots, not financing readiness.

top_operational_projects.title: Largest operational hydropower projects
top_operational_projects.caption: Operating MW are concentrated in a small set of larger plants.
top_operational_projects.caveat: Public-portal operating status and capacity values can lag commissioning updates.

wecs_basin_potential.title: WECS basin distribution of gross hydropower potential
wecs_basin_potential.caption: Gross hydropower potential is concentrated in the Koshi, Karnali, and Gandaki basins.
wecs_basin_potential.caveat: Gross potential is not equivalent to economically developable or transmission-ready capacity.

capacity_balance_fy2024_25.title: FY 2024/25 monthly capacity balance
capacity_balance_fy2024_25.caption: Monthly capacity contribution by IPPs, NEA plants, imports, and storage against national and system peak demand.
capacity_balance_fy2024_25.caveat: Monthly capacity-balance rows do not replace hourly dispatch or adequacy modeling.

export_revenue_fy2025_26.title: FY 2025/26 first-five-month export revenue
export_revenue_fy2025_26.caption: First-five-month FY 2025/26 export revenue peaks in Ashoj and collapses by Mangsir as dry-season conditions return.
export_revenue_fy2025_26.caveat: First five months only; this is not a full-year revenue curve.

potential_pyramid_funnel.title: Hydropower potential pyramid
potential_pyramid_funnel.caption: The headline theoretical hydropower number narrows sharply as physical, technical, economic, and delivery filters are applied.
potential_pyramid_funnel.caveat: Intermediate levels are compiled order-of-magnitude estimates, not definitive ceilings.

hydropower_license_map.title: Hydropower project licensing map
hydropower_license_map.caption: Licensed project locations cluster along Nepal's Himalayan hydropower arc.
hydropower_license_map.caveat: Static map is a portfolio snapshot; use the explorer map for current interactive filtering.
